meta.title: Arena
meta.description: Fly a match against the AI across six arenas. Cross lines and wear through your opponent's line before they wear through yours — while avoiding the cables and structures in the field.

briefing.title: Pick your opponent
briefing.lead: Beat one to unlock the next. Your loadout comes from the shop.
briefing.difficultyNote: Raised because you have cleared the ladder {count} time(s).

controls.title: Controls
controls.spoolHint: Drag up to haul in, down to pay out
controls.walkHint: Drag left or right to walk
controls.snapHint: Tap to yank — big tension spike, costs stamina

paused.title: Paused
paused.body: The match is waiting for you.

result.byTimeout: Time — you had more line left
result.byTimeoutAgainst: Time — they had more line left

advice.title: What to try next
advice.tension: Your line was slacker than theirs for most of the contact. Haul in before you cross, not after.
advice.overload: Your line broke under its own load. Ease off in the gusts — watch the load bar, not just the tension number.
advice.crash: You lost height and could not get it back. Wind is weaker near the ground, so recover early.
advice.close: That was close. One upgrade level either way would have decided it.
advice.solid: Cleanly done. Try the next rung.
advice.obstacle: You flew into something solid. Check the arena brief before a match — every structure on screen is exactly where the collision is, and the wind behind a tall one is much weaker than in front of it.
advice.cable: A cable took your line, not your opponent. Cables abrade without taking any damage back, so on a field with them the first job is keeping your kite above the wires — check the hazard list before you pick the field.

result.byCable: Your line was cut on a cable, not by them
result.byCableAgainst: Their line was cut on a cable

arena.title: Pick a field
arena.lead: The obstacles change the fight, not just the view. Cables cut, structures stop a kite dead, and tall buildings steal the wind behind them.
arena.cables: {count} cable(s) — will shred a line dragged across them
arena.clear: Open air, nothing in the way
arena.hint: Cables are the one hazard you cannot fight back against — they abrade your line and take nothing in return. On a field with cables, keep your kite above them.

sawah.name: Rice Fields
sawah.lore: Open paddy at dusk, one tree at either edge and nothing else in the way. The field everyone learns on.

pantai.name: Beach
pantai.lore: Sand between two headlands. The sea breeze is stronger and far less steady, and the rock faces cast dead air behind them.

kampung.name: Neighbourhood
kampung.lore: An alley between rooftops with four power lines strung across it. Drag your line over a cable and it is gone — the cable takes no damage back.

kota.name: City Block
kota.lore: Two concrete slabs straddling the middle of the field. Behind them the wind all but stops, and there is a lot of behind them.

monumen.name: Monument Plaza
monumen.lore: Overcast and gusty, with one tower tall enough that going over it is not an option. A line of trees to leeward.

viaduk.name: Viaduct
viaduk.lore: Arches across the whole arena and a tram cable along the deck. Climb over, or thread the gap and hope.

reason.cut: The line parted at the crossing.
reason.cable: The line was dragged across a cable.
reason.crash: The kite went into the ground.

leave.title: Leave the match?
leave.body: The duel is still going. Leaving now forfeits the round and the coins it would have paid.

setup.title: Ready to fly
setup.lead: Everything already has a choice made. Press Fly, or tap a card to change one.

note.1: One opponent, one line to beat.
note.2: Two opponents. They cut each other too.
note.3: Three opponents in a crowded sky.

bos-pasar.read: A big, steady bebean on a strengthened line, flown aggressively in gusty air. It commits to a crossing and rarely backs out of one.

tips.1: Out-turn it. Its sail steers at 2.6 against your starter's 3.2, so you decide the crossing angle — walk sideways until the lines meet square, because a square crossing bites hardest and a glancing one barely counts.
tips.2: Haul in the lulls, not in the gusts. This is the gustiest air you have flown in so far, and a gust already loads your line. Hauling on top of one pushes you past the red mark, where the line wears out with no opponent involved.
tips.3: Make it work. Its stamina is barely upgraded, and empty arms haul at about a third strength. Meet a crossing, take your exchange, then break off and let it spend itself.

bos-pasar.gear: One level of line strength. It carries two, and the gap is what you feel in every exchange.

raja-sawangan.read: The largest sail in the game on the toughest line you have met — four levels of line strength on an airframe that is already strong. It flies carefully and breaks off when it is losing.

tips.1: Do not try to saw through it. Its line outlasts a grind, and it has the discipline to disengage before you finish. Win in short, decisive contacts instead: arrive already hauled, and spend the yank at the moment the lines meet.
tips.2: It cannot follow you. At 2.0 steering it is the most sluggish thing you will fight, so the geometry is yours to choose. Take the side you want and it will still be arriving.
tips.3: Watch your own load. At 8.2 m/s your line sits high on the meter before you touch anything, and the temptation to hold a haul is what parts most lines at this tier.

raja-sawangan.gear: Stamina, then gelasan. You will be hauling in strong air, and running empty at the wrong moment loses the exchange you set up.

naga-senja.read: Everything at once: the sharpest reactions on the ladder, the best gelasan, the strongest line, and the wildest air. It will come to you and it will stay.

tips.1: Contact costs you more than it costs it. Its cutting power and line strength are both the highest in the game, so a long grind is a trade you lose. Engage only when you are the tauter line, and leave once you are not.
tips.2: Your own line is the first thing that will part. Gusts here are the strongest in the game, and a gust plus a haul is over the red mark. Most attempts at this fight end without the opponent doing anything.
tips.3: It steers a dragon with a very long tail. That is stable, not nimble — you can still pick the angle, and a square crossing is the only kind worth taking against a line this strong.

naga-senja.gear: Line strength to the top, then stamina. You cannot out-cut it; you can outlast the exchanges long enough to win them.

replay.title: This match, as a string
replay.body: Everything needed to run this exact duel again: the seed, the field, the loadout and every command you gave. Paste it back on the setup screen to watch it, or send it to someone who can look at what happened.
replay.copyFailed: Copy refused — select the text instead
replay.watchBody: Paste a replay string here. It runs the recorded match exactly as it happened, against the opponents it was recorded with. Nothing is scored — a replay never pays coins.

error.not-a-replay: That is not a replay string.
error.wrong-version: That replay is from a different version of the game and cannot be read.
error.malformed: That replay string is incomplete or damaged.
error.unknown-opponent: That replay features an opponent this version does not have.

replay.mismatch: This replay did not come out the same way it was recorded. The simulation has changed since — what you just watched is no longer the match that was saved.

bocah-sawah.name: Rice-Field Kid
bocah-sawah.title: First flyer
bocah-sawah.lore: Flies a plain pecut on a borrowed spool. Loses height constantly and has not worked out that hauling in is what cuts.

anak-kampung.name: Neighbourhood Regular
anak-kampung.title: Every afternoon, same field
anak-kampung.lore: Knows the field better than the kite. Keeps a steady line and will punish you if you stall, but rarely presses an advantage.

juara-lorong.name: Alley Champion
juara-lorong.title: Undefeated on one street
juara-lorong.lore: Flies a delta far too fast for their own good. Quick to reach a crossing, quick to over-commit.

bos-pasar.name: Market Boss
bos-pasar.title: Boss · buys the best glass
bos-pasar.lore: Runs a stall and a small kite empire. Flies a broad bebean that simply refuses to come down, and paid for gelasan that bites.

si-gelasan.name: The Glass Cutter
si-gelasan.title: All coins into one thing
si-gelasan.lore: Spent everything on abrasive and nothing on the line itself. Cuts brutally fast, but a patient opponent can outlast the frame.

sultan-angin.name: Wind Sultan
sultan-angin.title: Reads the gusts
sultan-angin.lore: Picks the windiest afternoons on purpose. Flies an eagle on a tight line and always seems to be a few metres above you.

raja-sawangan.name: Sawangan King
raja-sawangan.title: Boss · the humming kite
raja-sawangan.lore: You hear the bow before you see the kite. A heavy sawangan that pulls relentlessly and never gives back a metre of line.

naga-senja.name: Dusk Dragon
naga-senja.title: Final boss
naga-senja.lore: Flies the last light of the day. Reacts in a fifth of a second, wastes nothing, and will take the exchange the moment you let the line go slack.
